title: Alberta abandoned well surface locations
license: Alberta Energy Regulator attributed noncommercial reproduction. This is not an official version and is not endorsed by AER.
limitations: The source covers the published abandoned-well layer, rather than all Alberta wells. Locations are the original surface locations; revised locations are excluded. Orphan status is unknown. The download date and file modification date are separate. These locations are unsuitable for engineering or excavation.

title: Ontario petroleum well records
limitations: The source includes salt and storage wells, unlocated wells, potential wells and undrilled records. Original WELL_TYPE and WELL_MODE values are retained. Orphan status and completed reclamation are unavailable. An old plugging date does not override a later active or re-entered status. Coordinate accuracy varies by source.

title: British Columbia well surface locations

orphanJoin.comparison: decimal integer equivalence; 00001 equals 1; absent membership remains unknown

limitations: The source includes cancelled and undrilled authorizations. ABNZ means a zone was abandoned; whole-well closure remains unknown. The operator abbreviation may differ from the current owner. Restoration, closure and orphan status are separate fields. A missing match to the orphan inventory leaves orphan status unknown.

title: Saskatchewan designated orphan wells
publisher: Government of Saskatchewan, Ministry of Energy and Resources
license: Government of Saskatchewan Standard Unrestricted Use Data Licence v2.0
limitations: This source covers the orphan inventory, including records with completed abandonment, reclamation or transfer. An orphan designation may therefore refer to a past obligation. The listed licensee may have changed. Recorded event dates provide a partial history. The extract date is shown as published because its day/month order is unclear.

definitions.orphanStatus: Designated because the well is in the ministry orphan inventory. The ministry defines an orphan as an investigated site with no legally responsible and/or financially able party for abandonment and/or reclamation. Historical completion and transfer fields must also be inspected.
definitions.closureStatus: Completed abandonment status or a supplied abandonment date maps to abandoned. Required and other states remain unknown, not active or suspended.
definitions.reclamationStatus: Source CURRENT_ORPHAN_RECLAMATION_STA is preserved separately from wellbore closure.

method: ArcGIS ID enumeration followed by 200-ID batches with outSR=4326. All enumerated source features included.

title: Manitoba petroleum well locations
limitations: This downloaded inventory includes water, salt and potash test wells and cancelled authorizations. Original statuses are retained. Closure uses STATUS; MAP_STATUS can describe a directional surface location. Orphan and reclamation fields are unavailable. The public ArcGIS layer returned only one record during review, so this app uses the full download.

title: Yukon oil and gas wells
limitations: The source had 76 historical and active well records when checked. Locations are approximate. Orphan status, completed reclamation and a data observation date are unavailable. The displayed licensee comes from WELL_LICENSEE and may have changed. OPERATOR is a separate field and may be empty.
license: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Yukon.

title: Nova Scotia onshore petroleum wells, historical 2016 inventory
publisher: Government of Nova Scotia, Department of Energy
limitations: Archived 2016 source. Replaced in the explorer by the current provincial layer to avoid counting the same wells twice. Historical onshore records through February 1, 2016. Metadata updates do not change that observation date. The separate current viewer contains 143 records. Orphan and reclamation fields are unavailable. Original spud dates retain their published precision. Locations are approximate. The download contains 125 named wells and six empty placeholders with zero latitude. Those six placeholders are counted as exclusions.

reviewedExclusion.reason: Empty source placeholders projected from zero easting/northing to latitude zero. These are not identifiable well records.

title: Nova Scotia offshore directory of wells, historical inventory
publisher: Canada-Nova Scotia Offshore Energy Regulator via Natural Resources Canada
sourceDateDetail: Catalogue says directory last updated January 2020; current service layer title says Directory of Wells 2022. Exact record observation date is unresolved. Catalogue separately states all projects abandoned and decommissioned by November 2020.
limitations: Historical offshore wells and re-entries. The directory is dated January 2020 and the layer is titled 2022; the observation date is uncertain. All 211 records report P&A. Spud and termination dates describe drilling, so they are not used as abandonment dates. Record identifiers combine name, number and spud date to distinguish re-entries. Orphan and reclamation fields are unavailable. Locations use the service WGS84 geometry.

where: AREA IN ('Northeast Newfoundland Shelf','Grand Banks','Labrador Shelf','Newfoundland (West)','Labrador Sea')
license: Government of Canada noncommercial reproduction terms. Copy of BASIN Database, Natural Resources Canada, Geological Survey of Canada. Not an official version or government endorsement.
sourceDateDetail: BASIN is a historical exploration and drilling compilation. The service does not supply dates for individual status observations. Retrieval does not establish current status.
observationsThrough: Historical compilation. Status observation dates are not supplied.
scope: All BASIN records in the explicitly listed source AREA values. Other regions and ambiguous offshore areas are excluded by query.
limitations: Historical records from the BASIN compilation, grouped by the source AREA field. Coverage is partial. LOC_NO identifies a Geological Survey of Canada record; provincial licence numbers are unavailable. Status dates, orphan designation and reclamation status are also unavailable. Recorded statuses may have changed. Original attributes are retained. Locations use the service WGS84 coordinates, with varying source accuracy.
